# Vendored RinUI — placeholder

RinUI `0.4.4` is vendored here on **M5** (spec §3.3, §16.7), together with its
`LICENSE` and a `VERSION.txt` containing exactly:

```
RinUI 0.4.4 vendored from https://github.com/RinLit-233-shiroko/Rin-UI on 2026-08-28
```

RinUI is intentionally **not** a dependency in `pyproject.toml` to avoid two
copies of the library and non-deterministic imports.
